fusions.name: Two Tines Deep
fusions.desc: A two-pronged jab that strikes twice, each strike dealing 4 damage, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Branching Bolt
fusions.desc: Hurls a forked spike that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets within 9 tiles, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite. It then splits to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Sent the Other Way
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
